name: How long does a full kitchen remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full kitchen remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full kitchen remodel can vary significantly based on its complexity and the availability of materials. Generally, projects can take anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks from demolition to completion. Factors like custom cabinetry, structural changes, or permitting requirements in areas such as Alameda or Berkeley can extend this timeline. We will provide a detailed project schedule during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Full kitchen remodels typically take 6 to 12 weeks, depending on complexity and material availability. Structural changes or permitting can extend the timeline.
